description: This is a Java source file for an Android application activity named MainActivity. It demonstrates how to set up and use the ActionBar with tabs for navigation, including adding tabs and handling tab events.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity class extending ActionBarActivity to set up an ActionBar with tabs for navigation.

methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, and configures the ActionBar with three tabs.

methods.description: Inflates the options menu from the specified menu resource.
